title: The Best Cycling Deals From REI’s Holiday Sale
content:
REI’s Holiday Sale is back again. For your annual reminder of why it’s worth jumping on: REI has been closing all of its now 190+ physical locations across the U.S. on Thanksgiving and Black Friday since 2015, encouraging customers and employees alike to “Opt Outside.” The physical-shopping break means an earlier opportunity for finding deals online, with a sweeping sale that begins Nov. 13 (running through Nov. 23) marked by steep markdowns across numerous tried-and-true outdoor brands. 

While most markdown items benefit from 20-30% off, savvy REI shoppers will look closely at the deals for REI Co-op’s in-house brand gear. The sale also covers more than 3,000 styles sold at the store. There are plenty of big-ticket hard items like skis and snowboards, boots and bindings, tents, packs and racks. As always, REI Co-op members save more, with 20% on one full-price item and an extra 20% off one REI Outlet item (Use code HOLIDAY2026 at checkout; for exclusions and details, visit REI.com/coupon). REI Outlet shoppers can save up to 60% off select items from Nov. 17–19. 

REI Co-op members get access to additional benefits and offers, though terms and conditions apply to all:

  • Get free U.S. standard shipping (no regular customer $100 minimum required).
  • Save an additional 50% on a Hot Wax or Premium Wax at REI Co-op locations offering Snow Shop services. 
  • Earn 5% in card rewards on all purchases, even sale items, with the REI Co-op® Mastercard® .
  • Don’t have the REI Co-op® Mastercard®? Apply today and receive $30 in REI Co-op® Mastercard® Rewards approximately 7-10 business days after opening the credit card (must apply 11/10-11/23, approval required).
  • Get $150 off any REI Recommended and REI Exclusive trips over $1,500 USD. (must book 11/1–11/23 for trips 12/1-5/31/27).  

Dive in with the marked-down cycling goods that jumped out most to us. Given the wide selection of sale products, as well as depth of options (and colorways) from the inventories of proven brands, we started with ones we’ve tested and reviewed over the years. We selected some ideal gifts (at least more interesting than a standard set of new socks), plus identified a few big-ticket and high-performance products with steep discounts worth budgeting for yourself.   

PEARL iZUMi Attack Road Cycling Shoes (Women’s): $131 (25% Off)

This high-end dedicated road shoe is built on a 1:1 Composite Power Plate with a carbon insert (stiffness rating 8) that efficiently transfers power, while synthetic leather uppers stay durable and breathable. Zonal fit comes from a BOA Fit System with an L6E dial for quick midfoot microadjustments and a forefoot strap for set-and-forget tension. Dual cleat compatibility (2- or 3-bolt) adds versatility, and EVA and rubber heel bumpers with a 1 cm rise help with walking. 

Shop Now

Brooks England Flyer Saddle: $139 (25% Off)

Ideal for adventure cycling, commuting, and casual touring, this long-distance classic catches eyes with a vegetable-tanned leather top that molds to your shape over time, while treated nubuck leather shortens the break-in period. Suspension springs add cushioning on rough roads, and the steel rails and iconic Brooks backplate complete the look. At 30 ounces, it prioritizes comfort over weight savings as Brooks backs its leather saddles with a 10-year guarantee.

Shop Now

Ortlieb Gravel Pack QL2.2 Panniers (Pair): $161 (25% Off)

Built for gravel and touring loads, Ortlieb’s rugged, waterproof panniers are a good match for multiday tours and self-supported races. They hold 14.5 liters apiece, with roll-top closures and a PVC-free, polyurethane-coated ripstop nylon that stands up to weather and abuse. QL2.2 mounting hooks adjust without tools and fit racks up to 16 mm in diameter.

Shop Now

REI Co-op Trailmade Snap Fleece Mid-Layer: $52 (25% Off)

Gifting a simple, trail-ready fleece can round out your rider’s kit. The inner polyester grid adds the right warmth on cool days, and the UPF 50+ fabric wicks moisture and shields against the sun. Hidden front snaps let you vent when the climb heats up, while a zippered chest pocket, hand pockets, and a locker loop cover the basics.

Shop Women’s Shop Men’s

Five Ten Freerider Pro BOA Mountain Bike Shoes (Men’s): $127 (25% Off)

These high-grip, flat-pedal shoes pair Stealth rubber outsoles and the classic Dotty tread for strong pedal traction, with a lightweight EVA midsole for cushioning and flexibility. BOA Li2 dials allow on-the-fly microadjustments, and impact-resistant toe boxes add protection. The synthetic uppers on these all-day adventurers dry quickly and handle weather well.

Shop Now

Lazer Cerro KinetiCore Bike Helmet: $75 (25% Off)

Crossing seamlessly from paved to gravel, this versatile helmet’s KinetiCore technology enhances protection from rotational impact, and its TurnSys fit system delivers a stable, comfortable fit in seconds with a quick-snap buckle. The eyewear-friendly design lets you stash your shades without the temple arms pressing against your scalp. It has 18 vents and weighs 9.52 ounces (size medium). An optional Lazer LED light and Winter Kit (both sold separately) extend its range.

Shop Now

PEARL iZUMi Expedition Cycling Bib Shorts (Men’s): $116 (25% Off)

Storage is the standout on these well-featured bibs: two thigh cargo pockets with an interior mesh security pocket, plus rear pockets at the base of the straps. A dual-density ELITE Levitate 3D chamois helps dampen road chatter, while the soft nylon raw-edge bib upper and leg bands keep the fit seamless against skin. 

Shop Now

Vision Metron 60 RS Wheelset: $2,587 (25% Off)

Go big with your savings on this race-minded carbon aero wheelset, built entirely by hand. Hooked carbon rims run tubeless and pair with PRS hubs (V-1000), aero-bladed DP carbon spokes (21 front, 24 rear), and six sealed cartridge bearings. Vision developed it through extensive CFD analysis and wind-tunnel testing. At 49 ounces, the wheelset is compatible with Shimano HG or SRAM XDR freehubs.

Shop Now

Wahoo KICKR Smart Trainer: $680 (20% Off)

Wahoo’s V6 smart trainer maximizes your indoor riding with resistance that goes past 2,200 watts (accurate within +/- 1%), with automatic calibration, while the high-inertia flywheel, quiet belt drive, and KICKR AXIS feet recreate the side-to-side movement of riding outside. ERG Easy Ramp eases you back to your power target over 10 seconds if an interval is interrupted. Wi-Fi connectivity enables automatic firmware updates, with a Wahoo X trial included.

Shop Now
